verses.he: מִזְמֹ֗ור לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים נִצָּ֥ב בַּעֲדַת־אֵ֑ל בְּקֶ֖רֶב אֱלֹהִ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּֽט׃
verses.ar: مَزْمُورٌ لِآسَافَ ٱللهُ قَائِمٌ فِي مَجْمَعِ ٱللهِ. فِي وَسْطِ ٱلْآلِهَةِ يَقْضِي:
verses.en: A Psalm of Asaph. God standeth in the congregation of God; in the midst of the judges He judgeth:
verses.kjv: A Psalm of Asaph. God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.
verses.web: A Psalm by Asaph. God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

verses.ar: «حَتَّى مَتَى تَقْضُونَ جَوْرًا وَتَرْفَعُونَ وُجُوهَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ؟ سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: 'How long will ye judge unjustly, and respect the persons of the wicked? Selah
verses.kjv: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
verses.web: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.

verses.ar: اِقْضُوا لِلذَّلِيلِ وَلِلْيَتِيمِ. أَنْصِفُوا ٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱلْبَائِسَ.
verses.en: Judge the poor and fatherless; do justice to the afflicted and destitute.
verses.kjv: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
verses.web: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

verses.ar: نَجُّوا ٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱلْفَقِيرَ. مِنْ يَدِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ أَنْقِذُوا.
verses.en: Rescue the poor and needy; deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.kjv: Deliver the poor and needy: rid [them] out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.web: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

verses.he: לֹ֤א יָֽדְע֨וּ ׀ וְלֹ֥א יָבִ֗ינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָ֥ה יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ יִ֝מֹּ֗וטוּ כָּל־מֹ֥וסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.ar: «لَا يَعْلَمُونَ وَلَا يَفْهَمُونَ. فِي ٱلظُّلْمَةِ يَتَمَشَّوْنَ. تَتَزَعْزَعُ كُلُّ أُسُسِ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.en: They know not, neither do they understand; they go about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are moved.
verses.kjv: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
verses.web: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

verses.he: אֲ‍ֽנִי־אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִ֣ים אַתֶּ֑ם וּבְנֵ֖י עֶלְיֹ֣ון כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
verses.ar: أَنَا قُلْتُ: إِنَّكُمْ آلِهَةٌ وَبَنُو ٱلْعَلِيِّ كُلُّكُمْ.
verses.en: I said: Ye are godlike beings, and all of you sons of the Most High.
verses.kjv: I have said, Ye [are] gods; and all of you [are] children of the most High.
verses.web: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

verses.he: אָ֭כֵן כְּאָדָ֣ם תְּמוּת֑וּן וּכְאַחַ֖ד הַשָּׂרִ֣ים תִּפֹּֽלוּ׃
verses.ar: لَكِنْ مِثْلَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَمُوتُونَ وَكَأَحَدِ ٱلرُّؤَسَاءِ تَسْقُطُونَ».
verses.en: Nevertheless ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.'
verses.kjv: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
verses.web: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”

verses.he: קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁפְטָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה תִ֝נְחַ֗ל בְּכָל־הַגֹּויִֽם׃
verses.ar: قُمْ يَا ٱللهُ. دِنِ ٱلْأَرْضَ، لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ تَمْتَلِكُ كُلَّ ٱلْأُمَمِ.
verses.en: Arise, O God, judge the earth; for Thou shalt possess all nations.
verses.kjv: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
verses.web: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
